question: As long as MP (marginal product) remains higher than the average product (AP), the average product ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**continues to rise**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **As long as MP (marginal product) remains higher than the average product (AP), the average product continues to rise.**
 
• This is because the marginal product contributes positively to the average product when it is higher than the current average.
 
• Once the marginal product falls below the average product, the average product will start to decline.
 
• The relationship between marginal product and average product is crucial in understanding the stages of production and efficiency in economics.
 
• Monitoring these metrics helps businesses optimize their production processes and resource allocation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Marginal Product (MP)** is the additional output produced by adding one more unit of a specific input, keeping all other inputs constant.
 
• **Average Product (AP)** is the total output produced divided by the number of units of the input used.
 
• The **Law of Diminishing Marginal Returns** states that as more units of an input are added, the additional output produced by each additional unit will eventually decrease.
 
• Understanding MP and AP helps in determining the most efficient level of production and the optimal combination of inputs.
